### Key to the species of genus *Harmothoe*
1(2) Surface of elytra spotted, evenly covered with numerous claw-like spinules ..... 1. *H. imbricata* (Linnaeus)

2(1) Ventral chaetae slender, with two fine denticles at the tip ..... 2. *H. reticulata* (Claparède)

### 1. *Harmothoe imbricata* (Linnaeus, 1767) (Plate VI, 2a–2g)
why: 真实写法：Marinov 1977 b07.md 第 25–28 行，两条之间有空行，表后紧接种记述标题。
